description: This file contains helper functions for ASN.1 encoding related to 3GPP NR (New Radio) specifications, including conversions for Q-hysteresis, Q-offset range, PCI range, and allowed measurement bandwidth, with references to ASN.1 structures and external functions.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_q_hyst
methods.description: Converts a q_hyst_t enum to its ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_q_offset_range
methods.description: Converts a q_offset_range_t enum to its ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_pci_range
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 PCI range structure from pci_range_t, setting range value based on size, with error handling for invalid sizes.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_allowed_meas_bw
methods.description: Converts allowed measurement bandwidth enum to ASN.1 representation, with error handling for invalid values.
